text:
danny: Heads-up: at ~02:05 UTC we're seeing client cert issuance failing for svc-eu-west when talking to apac backend. ~6% of mTLS handshakes failing. Error in cert-service: 'KMSAccessDenied: user lacks kms:Sign on key/ephemeral'. Also some downstream proxies report chain verification errors.

priya: I noticed yesterday we rotated the intermediate CA in apac as part of the scheduled rollout (rotation batch #3). Did we update the cert distribution?

linh: Rotation completed but the intermediate bundle pushed to edge-cache in apac didn't include the new intermediate's AIA/OCSP endpoints. Proxies in apac tried fetching OCSP and got 502 from our proxy.

sam: Also, IAM audit shows a policy change (PR#4178) that tightened signer lambdas. The role used by cert-service lost `kms:Sign` and gained kms:Encrypt only. That would explain the 403.

claire: TL;DR two simultaneous regressions: mispacked intermediate (ca bundle missing AIA/OCSP) + RBAC change blocking KMS signing. Correlation looks real because failed requests correlate to the time of the RBAC deploy + CA stale cache TTL.

ops-bot: Deploy event: infra/policies@prod rolled at 2026-01-12T01:58:42Z by @infra-ops.

priya: Immediate mitigations: 1) revert RBAC change (restore kms:Sign) for service-cert-signer; 2) reload intermediate bundle in apac edge-cache with correct AIA/OCSP URLs; 3) temporarily increase cert-service retry/backoff on KMS 403 to reduce user impact while fix deploys. Who can own the RBAC rollback?

sam: I can own RBAC rollback. Will open emergency PR to re-add kms:Sign and add a constrained condition on resource/Tag:purpose=cert-sign. Will request hotfix deploy.

linh: I'll push the corrected CA bundle to apac edge-cache and purge the old bundle. Command I ran locally: `gsutil cp ca-bundles/intermediate-apac.pem gs://edge-cache/apac/` then `curl -XPOST https://edge-api.internal/purge?path=/apac/ca-bundles` (will run from bastion after approval).

danny: Ops: before purging, is there a chance in-flight connections will break? We should schedule a short maintenance window and drain connections if needed.

claire: The edge supports zero-downtime swap for cert bundles; purging is safe but we'll watch for a spike in handshake errors for 5m. I'll monitor telemetry.

sam: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4207 (emergency) - adds kms:Sign back with tight condition. Marked `hotfix=true`. Requesting expedited reviewer ping.

security-bot: Alert: cert-issuance-error-rate > 3% in eu-west -> triggered at 02:08 UTC. Linking SEC-2507.

linh: After edge reload, `openssl s_client -connect svc-ap-south.redwood.internal:443 -status` now returns OCSP response (good). Verification successful from eu-west bastion.

priya: Post-fix checks: 1) confirm KMS audit logs show successful Sign calls from signer role; 2) confirm OCSP stapling present on endpoints; 3) run cross-region mTLS smoke tests.

sam: KMS logs: `Sign` events recorded at 02:14 UTC from role arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/service-cert-signer. No more 403.

claire: Telemetry: handshake failure rate back to baseline after 02:20 UTC. Closing incident but filing follow-ups.

danny: Follow-ups: - SEC-2508: tighten RBAC change process: require canary + KMS policy integration test. - SEC-2509: CA bundle validation in CI (ensure AIA/OCSP present). - SEC-2510: add request_id propagation across cert service -> KMS -> edge for easier triage.

priya: Add runbook steps for 'intermediate rotation' including egress checks for OCSP and a preflight cert-refresh smoke test.

security-bot: Follow-ups filed: SEC-2508, SEC-2509, SEC-2510. Incident resolved. :white_check_mark:
